newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was at a standstill in the panhandle area late Monday. Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested at the close.

Feedlots reported light inquiry from buyers with bids at 66.00, most cattle priced at 68.00-69.00. Last established market was a very thin test Friday at 68.00. Offerings expected to show an increase over last week's numbers. 21,800 confirmed for the week to date including 21,100 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
